reviews.title: Watch me
reviews.comment: This is the monitor of monitors! I don't game but still has a great pic. All my devices are Samsung, so seamlessly works with all my tech. Picture is great, sound is there, use of ease is great.
reviews.author: FrankH

reviews.title: Great monitor except the integrated audio visual
reviews.comment: The monitor is sleek. The setup was a breeze. Everything worked great till I started using the integrated camera and microphone. They don't work well with MSFT Teams. The microphone is uselsss as no one can hear me. The camera takes about 5-6 try every time to switch it on. The integrated camera+microphone system is absolute disaster.
reviews.author: SatrajitM

reviews.title: Big, nice and just what i needed
reviews.comment: I love this monitor.  It makes my day to day much easier to accomplish.  I'm thinking about purchasing another to have a dual screen set up on my desk.
reviews.author: Speedy3

reviews.title: Nice monitor
reviews.comment: Nice looking monitor with great features including camera
reviews.author: JinC

reviews.title: Great screen, camera disconnects often
reviews.comment: Super nice size screen and nice optics. My only reason for not giving it a 5 star is that the camera and microphone do not work that well. I have to disconnect and re-connect the camera between every virtual meeting so that it connects and I have to turn the screen off at the end of the day so that the next day the microphone works well all day long, otherwise after a few days the microphone doesn’t work.
reviews.author: UserIMC
